data.name: Basmaah
data.gender_notes: Basmaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'basm' which means 'a gentle smile' or 'a pleasant face'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl in Islamic tradition. The name Basmaah carries the meaning “Gentle smile, a pleasant face” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basmaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle smile, a pleasant face and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner light and beauty of a soul
data.etymology: Basmaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle smile, a pleasant face.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basmaah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
